observations: A large office photocopier wrapped in clear plastic stretch film.
The brand 'SHARP' and model 'AR-M207' are printed on the front panel, visible in photos 0, 1, and 2.
A 'digital' logo is visible on the right side in photo 1.
Paper tray indicators for 'A4' and 'A3' are visible at the bottom of photo 1.
The machine is not powered on in any of the photos.
A watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' is overlaid on all images.

claims.evidence: No shipping documents or UK-specific power plugs are shown to verify origin.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: This is general marketing text and cannot be verified through static photos of a wrapped unit.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the control panel display may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine being plugged in, powered on, and reaching a 'Ready' state.

risks.risk: Internal components (drum, fuser, rollers) may be worn out, leading to poor print quality or jams.
risks.proof: A photo of a configuration page or a clean test copy/print produced by the machine.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full service and parts replacement

risks.risk: The machine may have a very high page count, indicating it is near the end of its service life.
risks.proof: A photo of the internal meter/counter reading from the display or a status printout.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and the screen functioning.
A photo of a test print or copy to verify print quality.
A photo of the total page counter/meter reading.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified, allowing for a valuation. Since functionality is not demonstrated, it must be priced at its worst-case value as a non-working unit.
